lines: Hester Drigers(?) and  Joseph F. Perkins  are named administartors of the estate of Corenlius
Hansley, late of Milford Neck, Kent County, DE. Isaac Jester and  Morris Mosley are named as appraisers on the 	estate on August 31st.
Inventory of the goods & chattels of Cornelius Hansley, dec'd, appraised August 31,

Hester Driggus and James F. Perkins Administrators of Cornelius Hansley dec. upon solemn oath say that they made due 	and deligent inquiry concerning the goods and chattels and moneys of the said Cornelius Hansley dec and that this 	Inventory doth contain all the goods chattels and moneys of the said Dec. which hath come to their knowledge.

We the subscribers, appointed by the Register, appraisers of the goods and chattels of Cornelius Hansley 		deceased, do on oath, respectfully say, that the goods and chattels in this inventory have been appraised by us at 	the sums set down against the same respectfully and that said sums are acording to the best of our skill and 		judgement, the true value of said goods and chattels in money. Dated, the 31st day of August
(signed) Isaac R. jester and Morris Mosley
A List of Goods sold at sale of Cornelius J. Hansley, deceased. Sept. 6,
List of Sales goes on for many pages. I hope to complete the full list sometime in the future.
Other familiar names appearing as purchasers are:
Joseph Perkins, Cornelius Burton, Alfred Mousley, Geo. S. Davis,
Nathaniel Mousley, Enoch Mousley, David Harmon, Andrew Mousley,
M. P. Jackson, Hester Driggus, Cornelius Johnson, Richard Hansley
